changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to title case. Removed 'constrained decoding' and 'reverse model' from models list as they are methods, not models. Added more precise output description. Kept only main NLG models evaluated.

Simplified BLEU-4 to BLEU base form. Removed duplicate entries and kept only the main metrics. Auto-tree accuracy is a variant of Tree Accuracy using reverse parsing, so consolidated under Tree Accuracy.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The paper uses human evaluation and automatic metrics, but no LLM-based evaluation.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline entries into a single normalized description. Normalized criteria to title case.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on compositional neural NLG for task-oriented dialogue using self-training with constrained decoding. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundant entries and incorrectly categorized methods as models. The paper conducts thorough human evaluations with clear criteria and uses standard automatic metrics.
